1.

He liveth, He liveth, our hope of salvation, He liveth in heaven’s height. Our eye unto Him in faith upward gazes, And the heart is filled with joy.

2.

He liveth, now shall we also live A life in resurrection’s power. The faithful word shall eternally stand, For Himself once hath said it.

3.

He liveth, He liveth, the same who once died For our sins upon the cross. We live in Him, He dieth no more, We sing resurrection’s song.

4.

He liveth and soon cometh again in the clouds; This hope now our comfort doth yield. From graves shall arise a rejoicing host At the Lord’s awakening voice.

5.

With this we shall be caught up in the clouds To meet and behold our God, To see fully accomplished the assembly’s hope, When the Bridegroom meets His bride.
